title: 第二十六章 策划第二十七章 对酒
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
“我们接下来的拍摄题材，可能会涉及一些具备危险性的内容。”
“到时候需要接触到澜海市本地的一些灰色产业，甚至可能遇到违法犯罪分子。”
“我不可能跟你打包票，说一定安全。”
“如果你对这方面有疑虑的话，我们可以再谈。”
说到这里。
徐慧紧紧盯着陈洛的脸庞，试图看出些什么。
毕竟。
能力、身体、学历等等，都是从表面，或是简单测试就能看出来的东西。
唯独一个人胆量、心态这些，只有真正遇到事情，才会暴露出来。
虽说陈洛作为一个还没毕业的大学实习生，她肯定不会让对方深入前线，和自己一起调查。
但作为司机，后援，关键时刻要是出岔子，依旧会很麻烦。
“没问题的，我心态还行，跑得也快。”
“真遇到什么事情，我能照顾好自己的。”
陈洛点着头，脸上依旧带着公式化的笑容，看不出任何异样。
他对于先前讨论的工作内容方面，其实十分满意。
身为实习生的他，既可以跟随团队，前往那些稀奇古怪的拍摄现场，接触各种各样的人。
而且，一些真正具备危险性的行动，还不需要他上场，安全性也有了一定保证。
再加上，外面的中年混混身上，还有两个词条等着他吸收。
陈洛自然没有任何理由，不接受这份工作。
“好。”

“那我们讨论一下具体的薪资待遇...”
双方心里都有了确定的答案。
接下来的事情，便是照常走个流程。
讨论完薪资待遇，确认双方意愿，徐慧便拿出一份简单的实习协议，供陈洛浏览签署。
“你什么时候能正式上班？”
面对徐慧的问题。
陈洛想起来，后天星期三，便是校运会开幕式的日子。
他报名参加的百米冲刺和一千五百米长跑的比赛，分别安排在开幕式结束后，以及当天下午举行。
“我学校后天还有点事情要处理，最快星期四就能上班。”
“好，没问题。”
确认完上班时间。
徐慧便踩着高跟鞋，领头走在前边，准备带陈洛准备认识一下公司的其他人。
来到办公区域。
中年混混两只脚翘在桌子上，抱着手机，一副咬牙切齿地模样，按着手机屏幕。
仿佛屏幕里，有他的杀父仇人。
content_en:
"The subjects we will shoot next may involve some dangerous content."
"At that time, we will need to come into contact with some local gray industries in Lanhai City, and we may even encounter illegal criminals."
"I can't guarantee you that it will be safe."
"If you have any concerns about this, we can talk about it again."
Speaking of which.
Xu Hui stared at Chen Luo's face closely, trying to see something.
after all.
Ability, body, education, etc. are all things that can be seen from the surface or through simple tests.
Only a person's courage and mentality will be exposed only when he encounters something real.
Although Chen Luo is a college intern who has not yet graduated, she will definitely not let the other party go deep into the front line and investigate with her.
But as a driver and backup, if something goes wrong at a critical moment, it will still be very troublesome.
"It's no problem. I'm in a good state of mind and I can run fast."
"Whatever happens, I can take care of myself."
Chen Luo nodded, with a formulaic smile still on his face, and there was nothing unusual about it.
He is actually very satisfied with the work content discussed previously.
As an intern, he can follow the team, go to those weird shooting scenes, and meet all kinds of people.
Moreover, some truly dangerous actions do not require him to play, and safety is guaranteed to a certain extent.
In addition, there are two entries waiting for him to absorb on the middle-aged gangster outside.
Chen Luo naturally had no reason not to accept this job.
"Okay."
"Then let's discuss the specific salary package..."
Both sides have a definite answer in their hearts.
The next thing is to go through the process as usual.
After discussing the salary and benefits and confirming the wishes of both parties, Xu Hui took out a simple internship agreement for Chen Luo to read and sign.
"When can you officially go to work?"
Facing Xu Hui’s problem.
Chen Luo remembered that the day after tomorrow, Wednesday, was the opening ceremony of the school sports meeting.
The 100-meter sprint and 1,500-meter long-distance races he signed up for were scheduled to be held after the opening ceremony and in the afternoon of the same day respectively.
"I have some things to deal with at school the day after tomorrow. I can get back to work on Thursday at the earliest."
"Okay, no problem."
Confirm working hours.
Xu Hui stepped on high heels and took the lead, preparing to take Chen Luo to get to know other people in the company.
Come to the office area.
The middle-aged gangster put his feet up on the table, holding his mobile phone in his arms and pressing the screen with a look of gritted teeth.
It was as if there was his father-killing enemy on the screen.
